title: Loaded Potato with {p} & {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). {?bakingpotato:Scrub the {s}, prick with a fork and bake 45 to 60 minutes, until soft.}{?!bakingpotato:Halve the {s}, toss with oil and salt, and roast cut side down 25 to 35 minutes, until golden and tender.}
Meanwhile cook the {p} with the {spice} until {doneness}{?egg:, scrambling the eggs until fully set}, then keep on a clean plate.
Sauté or steam the {v} until tender.
{?bakingpotato:Split the {s} and fluff the insides}{?!bakingpotato:Smash the {s} lightly with a fork} and pile on the {p}, the {v} and the {sauce}.
tip: Beans and plenty of veg on top, and a spoonful of yogurt in place of sour cream, make it a balanced meal.
